dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curve, moderately falcate from the posterior base to the acute apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep positive slope, approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convex curve fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-green internal luminescence with high-intensity highlights along the dorsal ridge and cranial surfaces.
